original_description: Add ChatGPT to your team so it can help you create, analyze and edit wireframes, diagrams and whiteboards – all in one context and workspace. ChatGPT can read project content, including designs, flows, screenshots, sticky notes, tables, annotations, and comments. ChatGPT can create and edit work directly in your Moqups projects, where your team can review, refine, and make decisions together.
